title: Black-Box Red-Teaming of Multi-Agent Systems via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems (MAS) to accomplish complex tasks. Prior black-box red-teaming attacks mainly focus on single agents, but we find that these methods are far less effective in MAS, where multiple sub-agents may not directly interact with the user. Therefore, we introduce ReMAS, the first reinforcement learning-based red-teaming framework tailored to MASs, which fine-tunes attacker LLMs to generate effective adversarial prompts for system prompt extraction. The framework follows a two-step process: first, a rewrite stage refines base attack prompts to increase extraction success, and second, a template generation stage constructs attack templates that improve the likelihood of invoking specific sub-agents and thus revealing their system prompts. translated_title: 基于强化学习的多智能体系统黑盒红队测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署在多智能体系统（MAS）中以完成复杂任务。以往的黑盒红队攻击主要针对单个智能体，但我们发现这些方法在多智能体系统中效果大幅下降，因为在多智能体系统中多个子智能体可能并不直接与用户交互。因此，我们提出了ReMAS，这是首个专为多智能体系统量身定制的基于强化学习的红队测试框架，它通过微调攻击者LLM来生成有效的对抗性提示词以提取系统提示词。该框架遵循两步流程：首先，重写阶段对基础攻击提示词进行优化以提高提取成功率；其次，模板生成阶段构建攻击模板，提高调用特定子智能体的可能性，从而泄露其系统提示词。大量实验表明，与现有的黑盒攻击相比，我们的方法显著提高了攻击成功率。
tldr: ReMAS是首个针对多智能体系统、基于强化学习的黑盒红队测试框架，通过重写阶段与模板生成阶段微调攻击者模型，显著提升了多智能体系统的系统提示词提取攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: ReMAS is the first reinforcement learning-based black-box red-teaming framework for multi-agent systems, which fine-tunes attacker LLMs through a rewrite stage and a template generation stage to substantially improve system prompt extraction attack success rates.
